course_name_original: Ik wil ondernemen! Starten van A tot Z (niet AJ 26-27)
course_name_en: I want to start a business! Starting from A to Z (not AY 26-27)

learning_outcomes.text: You generate innovative business ideas by using effective techniques.
You develop creative solutions for potential challenges in business ideas.
You apply divergent thinking techniques to explore a wide range of ideas.
You use the basic financial principles correctly.
You identify the administrative steps necessary to establish a company as a (student) entrepreneur.
You identify the different elements of a strong (personal) brand, such as unique value proposition, target audience, and brand identity.
You identify the different online and offline communication channels you can use to promote your personal brand.
You develop relevant marketing communication material for a relevant communication channel.
You apply essential sales techniques and negotiation skills to sell your products or services.
You use networking skills to build and maintain valuable business relationships.
You propose strategies to foster long-term customer relationships.
You apply effective presentation techniques in various contexts.
You speak confidently and effectively in front of an audience.

assessment_rules: The total grade is on a scale of 1-20. The portfolio accounts for 60% of the grade, split into 10% per module for modules 1-5 (50% total) and 10% for design and structure. The presentation (pitch) accounts for 40% of the grade, split into 20% for presentation and 20% for speaking. There are no partial transfers for resits.
